name: Model-Authored Creative SceneGraph Acceptance & Visual Quality Gate
first_commit_rule: Freeze prompts, canonical fixtures, metrics, thresholds, negative control cases and STOP before code
scope: OFFLINE MOCK MODEL RESPONSES ONLY; NO real model API, model authoring not proven
research_questions: Can a model-shaped candidate JSON be strictly accepted, validated by existing V2/V3 SceneGraph and grounded evidence, without rendering untrusted Python?
Can a native decoded-video visual QA gate detect sparse/static/copy-identical candidates and report objective measurements separately from teaching quality?
Can versioned rejection receipts differentiate wire, schema, evidence, topology and physical QA failures without storing provider output?
source: V3-51 three previously constructed HOST fixture storyboards wrapped as simulated untrusted JSON model responses; intentionally not independent genuine model samples
frozen_topic: Attention scaled-dot-product two-token example Q=(1,0), host QKV math, EXACT V3-51 ledger sha256

required_contract.data_envelope: strict versioned model-candidate JSON packet, scene dict with V3-51 semantic and schema validation, mock provenance only
required_contract.claim_scope: A1,A2,A3,A4 existing host ledger; no extra model-created math/code or unsupported relations
required_contract.allowed_animation: existing V3-51 finite graph/action IR only; V3-53 live provider compatibility NOT TESTED
required_contract.diagnostic_receipts: sanitized validation_stage,error_code,error_paths/types, hashes only; never raw provider data

physical_quality.video: actual H264+AAC 1280x720 15fps with exact beat-frame mux
physical_quality.meaning: This is a pixel/structural proxy, NOT readability by humans, not visual storytelling quality, not educational effect.

go_no_go: TECHNICAL OFFLINE PASS only if three physical MP4 and native receipts, full tests, both CI exact HEAD and visual QA; human quality UNRATED
